bioghist.head: Biographical Information
bioghist.p: The Virginia Board of Historic Resources is appointed by the Governor. This board votes on nominations for listing on the Virginia Landmarks Register.

The Virginia State Review Board is appointed by the Director of the Dept. of Historic Resources. This board makes recommendations to the Director on nominations for federal listing on the National Register of Historic Places.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Official minutes and related attachments of boards of the Virginia Dept. of Historic Resources. Includes the following: Historic Resources Board minutes, 1989-2003; State Review Board minutes, 1989-2003; Historic Preservation Foundation Board, 1989-1992; and Historic Landmarks Board, 1989.
